info.name: Cresilon News & Press Releases Posts API

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by object attribute.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously — `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,link,title`.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into the response.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to items with one of the given slugs.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit results to posts assigned to the given category IDs (1 = News, 1365 = Press Releases).

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Exclude posts assigned to the given category IDs.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit results to posts assigned to the given tag IDs.

params.name: tags_exclude
params.description: Exclude posts assigned to the given tag IDs.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit results to posts published after a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit results to posts published before a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: sticky
params.description: Limit results to sticky posts.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of published Cresilon news and press-release posts. Total item and page counts are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages response headers, and RFC 8288 `Link` headers carry `next` / `prev` relations. Verified live 2026-08-04: X-WP-Total: 36.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously — `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,link,title`.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into the response.

items.docs: Returns a single published news post by its numeric WordPress post ID.
